Code No: E-5772/N/AICTE
FACULTY OF ENGINEERING
B.E. (CSE) V - Semester (AICTE) (Main) (New) Examination, February! March 20173
Subject: Principles of Programming Languages
Time: 3 Hours Max. Marks: 76

Note: (i) First question is compulsory and answer any four questions from the
remaining six questions. Each questions carries 14 Marks.

1. a) List out Reasons for studying concepts of programming languages.
b) Derive a Parse tree with example grammar.
c) Define Record and Union.
d) Explain Guarded commands.
e) List out Design Issues for Functions.
f) Define Semaphore.
g) Differentiate between Functional and Imperative Programming languages.

2. a) Discuss different Programming Paradigms.
b) Explain Ambiguous Grammar with suitable examples.

3. a) Define subprogram and Explain its Features and types.
b) Explain Mixed mode Assignment and Compound statements with examples.

4. a) Describe the primitive data types and the design issues associated with them
b) Writes short note on different array categories with examples

5. a) Explain different modes for passing parameters to subprograms
b) Discuss in detail about the overloaded and generic subprograms

6. a) Explain different methods used for concurrency control.
b) Discuss in detail about logic programming languages

7. a) What you mean by FPL and explain fundamentals of FPL?
b) Demonstrate the abstraction modes available in python
